environment.description: Application deployed behind an internal NLB (network load balancer) with a sidecar Envoy proxy (v1.28) configured with a local rate limit filter on the listener chain. The Envoy local_ratelimit filter uses a token bucket with max_tokens=5, tokens_per_fill=5, fill_interval=60s, applied per-connection using the x-forwarded-for descriptor. The filter is configured with a stat_prefix of 'auth_limiter' and applies specifically to routes matching prefix '/api/v1/login'. The NLB target group health check path is /healthz. The Envoy filter chain also includes a Lua filter that adds a response header 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' but this is cosmetic. Note: the local rate limit is per-Envoy-instance and there are 3 instances behind the NLB, so theoretically 15 total attempts per minute across the fleet, but connection affinity is enabled via NLB flow hash (5-tuple) meaning a single source IP will consistently hit the same instance, effectively limiting to 5 attempts per 60 seconds from any single source.

config.network: private subnet, no direct internet access
